Outcome: Exploratory analyses prompted by the positive SVI-CCT association; not prespecified. All models are NB2 with dispersion estimated and a log(adults aged ≥45 years) offset; IRR per 10-percentile increase in the SVI or theme. Categorical RUCC uses indicator variables for codes 2-9 (reference, code 1). Log population density is residents per square mile of land area.
For cardiac MR the categorical-RUCC model is not estimable because no county coded 8 or 9 has an accredited CMR facility (quasi-complete separation).

Metropolitan counties by RUCC code: RUCC 1: 443 counties, 987 CCT and 493 CMR facilities, mean SVI 41.3, median density 367 per sq mi; RUCC 2: 385 counties, 284 CCT and 146 CMR facilities, mean SVI 51.9, median density 156 per sq mi; RUCC 3: 358 counties, 156 CCT and 69 CMR facilities, mean SVI 49.9, median density 95 per sq mi.

Within metropolitan counties, Spearman correlation of log population density with the overall SVI ρ = 0.11 and with each theme: theme 1 ρ = -0.00; theme 2 ρ = -0.03; theme 3 ρ = 0.37; theme 4 ρ = 0.20.

CCT = cardiac computed tomography; CI = confidence interval; CMR = cardiac magnetic resonance; EDI = economic deprivation index; IRR = incidence rate ratio; NB2 = negative binomial (quadratic variance); NE = not estimable; RUCC = Rural-Urban Continuum Code; SDI = Social Deprivation Index; SVI = Social Vulnerability Index.
